data.title: Home help request rejected by Muster BKK
data.summary: Your health insurer Muster BKK rejected your application for home help (Haushaltshilfe) during your hospital stay. The reason given is that no child under 12 lives in your household and the insurer's statutes offer no wider benefit.
data.explanation: Muster BKK has refused your request for a household helper during your hospital stay. Under § 38 SGB V this is only granted if a child under 12 lives in your household, or if the insurer's statutes provide more. The letter says neither applies. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person for the record at Muster BKK. The app shows the deadline for this. If you do nothing, the rejection becomes final. A social counselling service can help if you are unsure.
